title: Niko — Discord companion
hero.lede: Voice channels, moderation, an economy and an assistant — the jobs usually split across a stack of bots, in one app your members only have to learn once.
hero.meta: Free to start · No card · Four languages
voicemaster.label: VoiceMaster · live preview
voicemaster.caption: The bot’s real control panel. Press a button for the ephemeral reply it sends, or switch the language above.
features.body: The panel is Niko’s real VoiceMaster interface, wired to the same buttons the bot posts — press one. The replies shown with it are what the rest of the stack looks like in a channel.
inside.body: Nothing here is a checkbox on a feature list. Each one is a full system your staff can run without a manual.
inside.voice.title: Voice
inside.voice.body: Temporary channels members open themselves, run from a panel instead of a command list.
inside.moderation.title: Moderation
inside.moderation.body: Automod, raid protection, warnings and a log channel your moderators can actually read.
inside.economy.title: Economy
inside.economy.body: Jobs, banking, a casino, shops and leaderboards that give members a reason to come back tomorrow.
inside.assistant.title: Assistant
inside.assistant.body: A co-pilot with memory for the conversations that matter, and switches to turn it off per channel.
cta.title: Put Niko in your server.
cta.body: One invite, the settings you already know, and every command documented in the same four languages.

examples.ban.title: User Banned
examples.ban.note: Confirms first, clears the last 7 days of their messages, and writes the ban into your log channel.
examples.reminder.title: Reminder Set
examples.reminder.reply:
### {emoji} Reminder Set
I will remind you about **check the support queue** <t:{timestamp}:R>.
examples.reminder.note: Arrives in your DMs, or in the channel it was set in when the whole server needs to see it.
examples.level.message: gm! anyone up for a few rounds later?
examples.level.reply: Congratulations {user}, you leveled up to level **25**!
examples.level.note: Talking earns XP; level roles and announcements are set up once and then run themselves.
